item.title: Get iOS Push Notifications When Your Agent Finishes (or Fails)
item.author: David Twizer
item.description: Wire an xpander agent’s success/error webhook into hark.ryan.ceo and your phone buzzes the moment a long-running agent task finishes - no polling, no forgotten tabs.
